decisions.title: SPS 2.0 root is sps2/ within this repository, pending a standalone repository
decisions.decision: Build the SPS 2.0 foundation under a self-contained sps2/ directory so no legacy file is modified, no remote is created and no machine-global state is touched.
decisions.reason: The user authorised creating a new repository but specified no repository name, host or location. Creating a standalone git repository outside this workspace would write outside project-local scope and require inventing an unapproved destination.
evidence: Phase 05 DEC-0007 established SPS 2.0 is a NEW repository; the standalone git init step is deliberately deferred, not silently skipped.

alternatives.option: Convert the legacy repository in place
alternatives.rejected_because: Prohibited; would modify the reference system.

alternatives.option: Create a standalone repository outside this workspace
alternatives.rejected_because: No approved destination; would write outside project-local scope.

approval.basis: Explicit user approval of the P1 final report, 2026-10-03

decisions.title: No-emoji is machine-enforced, not documentation-only
decisions.decision: Enforce the global no-emoji rule with a repository scan plus a negative test rather than by documenting it alone.
decisions.reason: Phase 01 finding F-9 showed that documentation asserting behaviour is a proven defect class in the legacy system.
evidence: DEC-0008 established the no-emoji rule; finding F-9 established the documentation-only failure mode.
